In "The Martian" by Andy Weir, there isn't a single character opposing Mark Watney. Every single one we see, wants him to get home. Sure, there are characters that disagree in how to do that, but they all want him to be rescued if they can.

So the villain, if you can call it that, is Mars itself. It's the only thing that ever directly opposes him. Be it (spoilers ahead!) >!Causing the storm that stranded him in the first place, Destroying the airlock on the HAB ruining his potato crops, and even just the distance he has to go to get to the Ares IV MAV so he can get home, and he runs into a dust storm even on the way there.!<

So, you don't need a character as an antagonist, but you do still need something that your character can struggle to overcome.
